## Overview

An end-to-end analytical pipeline for TCGA-BRCA (breast cancer) genomic data. Raw clinical, somatic mutation, and RNA-seq data are downloaded from the NCI GDC, loaded into DuckDB, transformed with dbt, and analyzed with R.

## Pipeline

```
NCI GDC API
    ↓  (TCGAbiolinks / R)
DuckDB  →  raw.clinical
           raw.maf
           raw.rna_expression
    ↓  (dbt)
       staging.clinical
       staging.mutations
       staging.rna_expression
    ↓
       marts.tmb
       marts.survival
    ↓  (R / Quarto)
Survival analysis · Mutation landscape · Cox regression
```

## Stack

| Layer | Tool |
|---|---|
| Extraction | R, TCGAbiolinks, GDC client |
| Storage | DuckDB |
| Transformation | dbt-duckdb |
| Analysis | R, survival, maftools, ggplot2 |
| Publishing | Quarto, GitHub Pages |
